# canary opportunities reconcile-exercise --help · COLUMNS=80 · colour off
canary opportunities reconcile-exercise — Confirm one fully resolved exercise
using matching IBKR evidence; human terminal only

Usage: canary opportunities reconcile-exercise REQUEST_REF REVISION --evidence
       EVIDENCE_ID --confirm-complete [--json]

Flags
  --confirm-complete        attest that this exact request is fully resolved
                            with no quantity still pending; matching broker
                            evidence remains required
  --evidence STRING         unused matching evidence ID from opportunities
                            exercises
  --json                    emit the recorded human-attested broker-evidence
                            resolution
